title: Water cycle
summary: Water evaporates, condenses into clouds, falls as precipitation and collects before evaporating again.

visual.title: Water cycle
visual.description: Heat from the sun causes evaporation. Water vapour rises and condenses into clouds. Water falls as precipitation. It collects in oceans, rivers and groundwater, and the cycle repeats.

nodes.label: Collection
nodes.detail: Runoff gathers in oceans, rivers and groundwater
